method: Tiers within each size class: for each pair of setups, every task (24 per track, public and private) is one paired item, won by the setup that passed more of its 3 repetitions; ties drop out. Exact two-sided sign test, Holm-corrected over all pairs of the class, p < 0.05. Rows in accuracy order: the top row starts Tier 1, and a row starts the next tier when the test separates it from its tier's top row. Accuracy: both tracks (48 tasks); Renamed tools: each track (24 tasks). – : not tiered (class not verified, incomplete or not qualified).
